captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: Production context/memory/performance/appearance settings and real adaptive native worker. Fictional requests, memory-only Copy sink, per-model isolated profiles. See stage9-settings.json or stage9-performance.json. Verify mode reads embedded resources only.
limitations: No personal data, system clipboard, native color-picker gesture, physical input, power-cable operation or induced system memory pressure. Real results are recorded without substituting hardware readings. Reuse internals and failure fallbacks are checked separately.
